title: Mother with Children, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white vintage snapshot depicting a mother standing outdoors with her three young children in front of a corrugated metal wall. The mother wears a mid-1940s pinstriped dress with puffed shoulder sleeves while holding a toddler in a patterned dress. Beside her stands a young boy wearing a flat cap and striped shirt, and a young girl in a simple dress.
